name: Ceratops compatibility behavioral review
description: Internal requirements reviewed from repository declarations, implementation, and observed execution. No external evidence registry governs Ceratops compatibility. A structural checker result alone cannot establish these requirements.

checks.applies_when: The repository has the required validator environment.
checks.review_required: The repository validator runs through uv using its declared tooling project, compatible Python, and locked dependencies. uv owns setup before Python starts; validator code does not install dependencies. Application and test environments remain repository-owned and need not share the validator environment. Normal execution preserves the lock; dependency updates are explicit. The generated tooling project resides directly under scripts; generated tooling commands select it explicitly. Dependency declarations need one owner per environment; a requirements file is not required alongside pyproject.toml and uv.lock.

checks.applies_when: The repository declares deliverables or contains Python tests.
checks.review_required: Repository validation never executes tests. SDLC declares separate tests for each deliverable, with explicit no-op reasons when appropriate; repository tests may cover shared behavior. Python test repositories have the template-created run-tests.py and SDLC wiring. Review ambiguous detection and preserve repository-owned framework, test cases, custom commands, and environment choices. Promotion, shipping and CI require their applicable validation and test results separately.

checks.applies_when: The repository declares lifecycle operations or deliverables.
checks.review_required: Owning helpers select and execute validation and tests from SDLC before the selected mutation, stop on failure, and clean their owned temporary artifacts. CI never dispatches skill handoffs and reports deferred routes separately. Skill callers may execute registered deterministic handoffs; unresolved routes remain pending and cannot authorize later mutation. Generic lifecycle helpers do not hardcode skill implementations. The copied SDLC runtime must work in a repository without installed Codex skills.

checks.applies_when: Ceratops compatibility is applied or its generator changes.
checks.review_required: Create or reconcile required files from declared templates and register the isolated validator project with dependency maintenance. SDLC is required in the current compatibility format; supported older formats remain executable outside application. Preserve target-owned operations, dependencies, test implementations, skill declarations, and file modes. Block ambiguous custom rewrites before mutation. Perform setup and structural verification inside the rollback boundary; restore changed target files after failure and remove newly created environments owned by the failed application. Report unresolved behavior without claiming full compatibility. Skill-bearing targets receive shared Python launcher payloads and starter locked declarations. Review skill-specific dependency coverage before claiming the deployed helpers are ready.

review_result_values.pass: The applicable requirement is supported by concrete local evidence.
review_result_values.fail: Local evidence demonstrates an unmet requirement.
review_result_values.not_applicable: Record why the requirement does not apply to this repository.
review_result_values.blocked: Required evidence is unavailable; do not infer success.
review_result_values.approved_drift: Record the exact user-approved exception and retained consequence.
